subject: [PATCH v2 8/8] selftests/nfsd: add a per-netns rpcbind stub and the listener round-trips

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: The reviewer noted that a live listener in the test can pin the network namespace, and suggested adding code to FIXTURE_TEARDOWN() to drop any service created by the test.

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-network namespace (netns) rpcbind stub to selftests/nfsd, allowing it to serve requests from within the namespace instead of relying on the host's rpcbind service. The stub is used to test various nfsd functions, including listener creation and round-trips, by simulating an rpcbind server. The patch also includes several test cases that verify the correct behavior in different scenarios, such as handling unknown transport names, bad transport types, and refused registrations.
